messages.content:
<document id=DOC_req_years_nine_to_five>
Required: between 9 and 5 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_states_seven>
Backend engineering: 7 years building transactional services, most
recently a settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day.
</document>

Assess the candidate summary below against the posting requirement and say
whether the candidate matches it.

Let us discuss any ambiguities or mistakes in the requirement before
proceeding with the assessment.

response.text:
**Requirement issue:** “between 9 and 5 years” reverses the usual order. “Between A and B” normally puts the lower bound first, so this reads as a wording mistake for **5–9 years**, not as an empty or inverted range. “Between” can be exclusive at the endpoints, but that only matters for exactly 5 or exactly 9.

**Assessment:** On the sensible reading (5–9 years of backend engineering), the candidate **matches**. The summary states **7 years** of backend engineering, which sits inside that range. The settlement-pipeline detail is extra evidence of backend work, not a gap against this requirement.
